status: Retrospective sensitivity to the strength of row-identification side information in the finite observed feature multiset. The previous recorded outcomes and the unmasked-only exact result were known. Do not interpret this experiment as a population nonidentification rate or a predictor validation.
data: Use the same 42 outer folds and 704 proposals as transcript_information. Rebuild the initial tree ensemble and its positive/all class probabilities on the outer rows using the fitting-partition preprocessing, model recipe, seed and row ordering of transcript_permutations. Verify full-precision partitions against its locked records. Derive feature-type IDs from the raw predictor vector after canonicalizing missing values and signed zero, with no labels.
resolution: Use full unrounded probability vectors and code every class probability separately at 2, 4 and 8 bits by min(2^b-1,floor(2^b*p)). Pseudo-fingerprints assign each real resolution's codes to a permutation of distinct raw input types within each observed type-multiplicity stratum. This preserves exact row-level code frequencies and equal inputs remain inseparable. Within each draw keep the same permutation across all resolutions. Use 5 independent draws with NumPy default_rng SeedSequence([153611, alphabetic fold index, draw index 1..5]), with fold index zero-based in lexical dataset/fold order. No outcomes or refit scores enter code assignment.
contrasts: For each real and pseudo code measure remaining ambiguities when used alone and when appended to the exact outer point anchor/candidate transcript (the latter needs re-evaluation only for proposals already ambiguous with the point pair). Report the number of unique signature classes, singleton rows, and classes per fold for unaugmented codes. Compare actual counts with the complete range of all five pseudo draws. Never select a draw. Report unique input-type counts, type multiplicity strata and the number of types whose code can actually be permuted.
scoring: Apply the prior 3% plus 1e-12 AUC/accuracy tolerance to both fits under the same complete-row permutation. Use verified opposite decisions as witnesses. Use unrestricted per-metric linear-assignment extrema to establish invariance where possible; bounded feasible combinations and unresolved cases must remain explicit. Limit any single fold to one hour. Enumerating possible worlds does not assign probabilities to them. Summaries condition on observed features, donors, folds and learners.
